summary:
ITER 180 — Backend 9/9 GREEN after fixing one critical P0 bug. FOUND + FIXED: GET /api/financial-models/templates/inputs.xlsx?model_id= queried Mongo by 'owner_user_id' but financial-model documents are stored with 'user_id' (see /app/backend/routes/financial_model.py:331) — the lookup ALWAYS returned None so the template was NEVER pre-filled, regardless of model_id. Replaced with 'user_id' and verified the template now contains the saved assumptions (Year-1 revenue=7,654,321 / Gross margin %=42 / WACC %=19). All async-import-job, sync-import regression and Google-Sheet/Excel template-import flows are GREEN. Frontend FM Inputs tab regression VERIFIED on mobile (390x844): every required testID renders (fm-template-dl, fm-wacc-direct, fm-wacc-capm, fm-import-xls, fm-import-sheet, fm-tab-iimb, fm-tab-pnl, fm-tab-valuation). Step2 file-import progress flow exercised at API level (start → poll → done) and source-verified (testIDs step2-file-pick:Step2.tsx:1051, step2-file-import:1118, step2-file-progress:1123) — could not deep-link into the MyDezider wizard for a live tap-through, but the async pipeline that the progress UI polls is proven working end-to-end via pytest.

BACKEND DETAIL (BASE=https://repo-blueprint-1.preview.emergentagent.com, login → session_token):
  • Async happy path: chunked upload (filename+chunk_b64 final=true) → POST /api/file-import/decision/{id}/start {filename,upload_id,ai_tier:'fast',crawl_web:false} → 200 {job_id}. Polling GET /api/file-import/jobs/{job_id} progresses through stages and lands on status='done' with result.factors/result.options (small TXT, fast tier, ~6–10s). ✓
  • Error cases: GET /api/file-import/jobs/does-not-exist-xyz → 404 ✓; POST .../start with no upload_id → 400 ('upload_id is required …') ✓; POST .../start on a fake decision id → 404 ('Decision not found') ✓.
  • OLD synchronous endpoint regression: POST /api/file-import/decision/{id} {filename,upload_id} still returns 200 with factors/options merged into the decision ✓.
  • Template (blank): GET /api/financial-models/templates/inputs.xlsx → 200 xlsx, value cells empty ✓.
  • Template (prefilled — AFTER FIX): GET /api/financial-models/templates/inputs.xlsx?model_id=<own_model_id> → 200 xlsx with the saved assumptions populated (Year-1 revenue=7,654,321, Gross margin %=42, WACC %=19) ✓.
  • POST /api/financial-models/import-file (filled .xlsx via chunked upload) → 200 {patch:{year1_revenue:9000000, gross_margin_pct:55, wacc_pct:18}, found:[…]} ✓.
  • POST /api/financial-models/import-sheet {sheet_url:'https://example.com/not-a-sheet'} → 422 'Paste a valid Google Sheets link.' ✓.

FRONTEND DETAIL (mobile 390x844, session_token injected into localStorage):
  • /tools/financial-model?org=<seeded>&goal=<L1> renders the Inputs tab; every required testID present: fm-template-dl ✓, fm-wacc-direct ✓, fm-wacc-capm ✓, fm-import-xls ✓, fm-import-sheet ✓, fm-tab-iimb ✓, fm-tab-pnl ✓, fm-tab-valuation ✓.
  • MyDezider deep-link into Step 2: /tools/new-decision?id=…&step=2 redirected to the dashboard (the wizard expects in-app state navigation, not URL params) — could not exercise the file-import dialog through Playwright. Step2.tsx source verified: testID 'step2-file-pick' at line 1051, 'step2-file-import' at 1118, 'step2-file-progress' at 1123 (visible whenever fileProgress text is set during the async job poll). The job-poll API it depends on is proven working (see backend tests).

action_items: (NONE blocking) Main agent: confirm the financial_model.py one-line fix (owner_user_id → user_id) is acceptable. With it, ?model_id= prefill works end-to-end and matches the iter180 spec.

(optional) Add a deep-link route for MyDezider so QA can open a specific decision at a specific step (e.g. /decision/{id}/step/2). Today /tools/new-decision?id=…&step=2 redirects out, so the live Step 2 file-import progress UI cannot be exercised via deep-link in CI/Playwright. The underlying job-polling pipeline is otherwise proven working at the API layer.
critical_code_review_comments: [BUG, NOW FIXED] /app/backend/routes/financial_model.py:331 — download_template() queried db.financial_models by 'owner_user_id' but documents are stored with 'user_id' (see create_model at line ~119). This silently broke the entire iter180 'prefill template by model_id' feature: the find_one() always returned None, so values stayed None, so the template was always blank. Replaced with 'user_id' and verified prefill works.

/app/backend/routes/file_import.py — async job loop is clean: progress() schedules a Mongo update via asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe, decision-ownership is checked before the upload_id is enqueued, and final state is always set (done / error). Error mapping (404 for missing decision / missing job, 400 for missing upload_id and assemble failures, 413 for >100MB) matches the spec.

/app/backend/routes/file_import.py — `_run_import_job` always calls `chunk_upload.discard(upload_id)` in finally even when assemble() succeeds (assemble already discards the assembled session), so the discard is idempotent — keep an eye on this if chunk_upload ever starts raising on double-discard.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth POST /api/auth/login returns session_token (40 chars). Chunked-upload chunk payload key is 'chunk_b64' (NOT data_b64); pass final:true on the last chunk. Async file-import flow: /api/uploads/init → /api/uploads/chunk → POST /api/file-import/decision/{id}/start {filename, upload_id, ai_tier, crawl_web, context} → {job_id}; poll GET /api/file-import/jobs/{job_id} every 1–2s until status in {done, error}. Small TXT lands in ~6–10s on the 'fast' tier. Template prefill: GET /api/financial-models/templates/inputs.xlsx?model_id=<own_model_id> returns an xlsx whose value-column cells equal the saved assumptions (verify with openpyxl.load_workbook, look up rows by column-A label substring like 'Year-1 revenue', 'Gross margin', 'WACC'). The frontend wizard does NOT accept ?id=&step=2 deep-link — to test Step 2 UI live you must navigate in-app via the home → decision → step flow.
rca_of_issue: Symptom: ?model_id= had no effect — the downloaded template was identical with or without it. RCA: /app/backend/routes/financial_model.py download_template() filtered db.financial_models by {'id': model_id, 'owner_user_id': user['user_id']}, but documents inserted by POST /api/financial-models store the owner under 'user_id' (see create_model). The find_one() therefore never matched, the local `values` stayed None, and fin_template.build_template_xlsx(None) emitted a blank template every time. Mitigation applied: changed 'owner_user_id' → 'user_id'. Verified with a fresh model carrying distinctive assumption values (7,654,321 / 42 / 19) — those exact values now appear in the downloaded xlsx; without model_id the value cells remain empty, confirming there's no accidental leakage.
